mechanism: Selegiline (selective MAO-B inhibitor at low doses) combined with fluphenazine (dopamine antagonist) may cause additive CNS depression and potential hypertensive crisis or serotonergic complications, particularly at higher selegiline doses where MAO-A inhibition becomes non-selective.
action: Avoid combination or use with extreme caution; if necessary, monitor closely for hypertensive episodes, extrapyramidal symptoms, altered mental status, and serotonin syndrome; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower interaction potential.
